Name: Searing Birdcage
Components: V, M (the burnt feather of a goose)
Description:
You invoke the spirit of a flaming goose that manifests above a target creature within reach and have it then judge their sins. The creature must pass a Wisdom saving throw or suffer 4d4 fire damage and 4 Burn count.

If the creature has committed any of the following since the start of their last turn, they suffer additional effects upon failing this saving throw:

• Killed or knocked another creature Unconscious.
• Cast a spell by spending a spell slot.
• Spoke ill or disrespected the core beliefs of a non-Evil aligned deity.

Upon committing any of these sins, the creature suffers 4d12 fire damage instead as a cage of searing feathers comes to bind them. They also suffer 8 Burn count instead, have their movement speed reduced to 0-ft. and a -3 negative modifier to Dexterity saving throws until the end of their next turn.

If they have committed two or more of these sins, they have Disadvantage on the saving throw.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, you may select an additional target for each slot level above 5th.
